lines.zh: 我一步一步走，脚下有杂音
lines.en: I walk step by step, static underfoot
The image on me keeps flickering
I walk crooked, like an unstable signal

lines.zh: 地面被我踩出一格一格的痕
lines.en: My steps leave square marks in the ground

lines.zh: 我抬腿的时候，身体断了一下
lines.en: When I lift a leg, my body cuts out
I walk along the edge of the screen

lines.zh: 声音从我身体里飘出来，不是我的
lines.en: Sounds drift out of me, and they are not mine

lines.zh: 我走两步，颜色就变一次
lines.en: Two steps and my colors change

lines.zh: 这片地方，我也说不清在哪
lines.en: I could not say where this place is either
I shift slowly, as if loading

lines.zh: 我一动不动地停了一会儿，又走
lines.en: I stop a moment, then walk again
A trail of afterimages drags behind me

lines.zh: 我脚下的地面，一块一块地加载
lines.en: The ground under me loads in patches
When I walk, the sound follows

lines.zh: 我停一下，周围也停一下
lines.en: I stop, and everything around me stops
I stand there and the picture shakes

lines.zh: 我脸上本该有眼睛的地方，没有
lines.en: Where my eyes should be, there are none
Sounds come out broken
I tilt my head, as if stuck
The colors around me have faded slightly

lines.zh: 我不太清楚自己是什么
lines.en: I am not quite sure what I am
My shadow jumps about on the wall

lines.zh: 我等了很久，时间有点乱
lines.en: I have waited long, and time is confused

lines.zh: 我抬手，手停了一下才到
lines.en: I raise a hand and it arrives late
Around me, the quiet is fake

lines.zh: 我数着雪花一样的噪点
lines.en: I count the static like snow
My colors are slightly off
On my side, wind moves nothing

lines.zh: 我站着，像一帧没播完的画面
lines.en: I stand like a frame that never finished playing

lines.zh: 我等一个不会来的东西
lines.en: I wait for something that will not come
Are you watching me too
Do you know this face
You should not appear here
I stare without moving

lines.zh: 你的样子，在我这边不太稳定
lines.en: Your shape is not stable on my side

lines.zh: 我听见你的声音，可听不清
lines.en: I hear your voice and cannot make it out

lines.zh: 我离你越来越近，不是走过来的
lines.en: I get closer, and not by walking

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我换了个位置
lines.en: When you blinked, I moved

lines.zh: 我身上有个错误，越来越明显
lines.en: There is an error in me, growing clearer

lines.zh: 你要找的出口，不在这儿
lines.en: The exit you want is not here
There is a me behind you too

lines.zh: 我们见过的，你想不起来
lines.en: We have met, and you cannot recall it
You look at me, I look at you

lines.zh: 你脸上有一点我不明白的东西
lines.en: There is something on your face I do not understand
You will not remember this face clearly
I flickered
My edges have smeared
That cost me a segment
The sound cut out
I am not sure whether I feel it
The picture froze for a frame

lines.zh: 你的动作，我慢了半拍才反应
lines.en: I reacted half a beat late

lines.zh: 我这里，这种东西不算什么
lines.en: On my side, such things mean little
My shape has changed again
Look, I am still here
You hold something out to me
I do not eat, and I want it

lines.zh: 你的手在我这边，会出现两次
lines.en: Your hand appears twice on my side

lines.zh: 这东西看起来不该存在
lines.en: This thing looks like it should not exist
Holding it makes the picture shake
I reach out, and half my hand is missing
What happens if you give it to me
You had better put it away
Take it further off, it is too bright
Holding it up makes the picture unsteady

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，可我需要别的东西
lines.en: I need no food, I need something else

lines.zh: 你给的东西，会留在这边
lines.en: What you give stays on this side

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，会多出一个
lines.en: What you set down becomes two

lines.zh: 我不拿走它，它也会跟着我
lines.en: I am not taking it, and it follows me anyway
You had better not offer more
You hit me and I shuddered
My hand passed through your shoulder
Do not touch me, I come apart

lines.zh: 这一下，你的画面也花了
lines.en: At that, your image blurred too

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，会互相干扰
lines.en: Pressed together, we interfere

lines.zh: 你退了，可你还在我这儿
lines.en: You stepped back, and you are still here with me

lines.zh: 你的轮廓在我这儿叠成两层。
lines.en: Your outline doubles over on my side.
At that touch, I lost a segment
You need to look again
Touch again and we are both scrambled
I have nothing like that

lines.zh: 你要的是一个不存在的东西
lines.en: What you want does not exist

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是谁的？我忘了
lines.en: Whose face is this? I forget
There is a layer between us
The closer you get, the less I am myself
I do not need an answer
There is only a loop here

lines.zh: 我一直在重复同一句话
lines.en: I keep repeating the same line

lines.zh: 你现在听见的，可能是第二次
lines.en: What you just heard may be the second time
Stop looking behind you

lines.zh: 我伸手去拿，拿到了两个
lines.en: I reach and take two
One of them is not real

lines.zh: 这东西在我这边是空心的
lines.en: On my side this is hollow
I hold it and it shakes
I should not have touched this
It fell without a sound
I saw its back
I give it back to you
You keep it, I am done
I know where you are
The picture stuttered

lines.zh: 我站在你不该站的地方
lines.en: I am standing where you should not stand

lines.zh: 这里的一切都偏了一格
lines.en: Everything here is off by one

lines.zh: 我从那边过来了，没走路
lines.en: I came from over there, without walking
Are you counting my footsteps

lines.zh: 我这儿的时间比外面慢
lines.en: Time runs slower on my side

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就在你前面
lines.en: You take a step and I am ahead of you

lines.zh: 这句话，你听了第三遍了
lines.en: You have heard this line three times now
My voice is beginning to double

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，我就出现在哪儿
lines.en: Wherever you go, I appear

lines.zh: 你听见的声音，是从我这儿来的
lines.en: What you hear comes from me

lines.zh: 我没有走，我一直在这儿
lines.en: I have not moved, I have always been here
You are running, and the distance has not changed

lines.zh: 你回头看时，我在更前面
lines.en: When you look back, I am further ahead
This level has only one exit
Your footsteps are repeating

lines.zh: 又一场致命错误，锁定你了。
lines.en: Another fatal error. You're locked in.

lines.zh: 我的手在你肩上，冰冰的
lines.en: My hand is on your shoulder, cold

lines.zh: 这一下是从别的方向来的
lines.en: That came from a different direction

lines.zh: 你的视线里，我少了一截
lines.en: In your sight, a segment of me is missing

lines.zh: 你被推了一下，可没人碰你
lines.en: You were pushed, and nobody touched you
A little garbage falls out of me
Your wound is in the wrong place

lines.zh: 这一抓，留下了一道错位的痕
lines.en: That left a displaced mark

lines.zh: 你不该相信我站的地方
lines.en: You should not trust where I stand

lines.zh: 你被自己的影子绊了一下
lines.en: You tripped on your own shadow
After that, your ears are ringing
The picture shook first
I come out of a layer of static

lines.zh: 地上多了一个影子，两个
lines.en: There is a shadow on the ground, then two
Did that noise reach you
The colors are misaligned here
The way I appeared is not quite right
There was no me in this frame before
My image is still settling
The sound arrives first, then I do
I am where you were just looking
A line here has gone crooked
I stand and touch nothing

lines.zh: 火在我这边不烧，只变颜色
lines.en: Fire does not burn on my side, it only changes color

lines.zh: 我掉下去，一直掉，没有落地
lines.en: I fell and kept falling, without landing
Water came in, the picture all ripples

lines.zh: 炸开之后，你看见的是碎片
lines.en: After the blast, you see fragments

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，洞在别的地方
lines.en: The arrow passed through, the hole is elsewhere

lines.zh: 那股劲儿把我的画面纠了一下
lines.en: That force twisted my picture

lines.zh: 我这边，饥饿只是一个参数
lines.en: On my side, hunger is only a parameter

lines.zh: 雷亮的一瞬，我整个白了
lines.en: At the flash, I went entirely white

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，连我也快没了
lines.en: There is nothing here, and even I am going
